mechanisms.name: stress concentration-induced cracking of brittle phase

evidence.quote: the cracks in NiAl-32Cr-6Mo-6Ta and NiAl-32Cr-6Mo-8Ta alloys all pass through the primary Cr 2Ta phase from Fig. 7(c) and (d), which is due to the stress concentration leading to the cracking of the hard and brittle Cr 2Ta phase.
